subject: Reject dunker
object: jump to block at the peak of the jump
text: To reject a dunker, wait until the dunker reaches the peak of his jump, then jump to block.

evidence.quote:
To reject a dunking player, it's best to wait until the dunker has reached
the peak of his jump before you jump to block.

subject: Reject low dunk
text: A low dunk such as an easy jam can be rejected by knocking the dunker down with turbo and steal.

evidence.quote:
Another way to reject a dunker is to knock him down (turbo and steal) if
it's a low dunk like an "easy jam".

subject: Block shot
object: jump at the same time as the shooter
text: To block a shot, jump at the same time you believe the shooter will jump.

evidence.quote:
To block a shot, you need to jump at the same time you believe the shooter
will jump.

subject: Block shot
object: let shooter shoot, then grab rebound
text: The author lets the shooter shoot while standing in his face, then grabs the rebound or lets a teammate get it.

evidence.quote:
I usually let the shooter shoot while I'm in his face (but not
jumping) and then I'll grab the rebound (or my teammate will).

subject: Block buzzer 3-point attempt
object: press turbo and jump toward the shooter
text: It is possible to block the buzzer 3-point attempt by pressing turbo and jumping toward the shooter right after the ball is passed inbounds.

evidence.quote:
possible to block the buzzer 3-point attempt. Right after the ball is passed
inbounds press turbo and jump and point toward the shooter.

subject: Steal
text: One steal technique is to stick close to the opponent and press steal a lot.

evidence.quote: 1) stick close and press steal a lot. This is not my technique, so

subject: Steal
text: Steal by knocking opponents down, which can be repeated continuously against computer opponents until they drop the ball.

evidence.quote: 2) knock 'em down. It's more fun, and can be done continuously to computer opponents until they drop the ball.

subject: Steal
object: jump before a shot reaches the basket
text: Steal by letting a player shoot while you are near their basket and jumping before the shot gets there, though you may be called for goaltending.

evidence.quote: 3) let a player shoot while you're near their basket, and jump

subject: Rebound
object: press shoot after the ball hits rim or board
text: To rebound, press shoot to jump toward the ball after it has hit the rim or board.

evidence.quote: 1) press shoot to jump toward the ball AFTER it has hit the rim or board.

subject: Rebound
object: knock down opposing players near the ball
text: To rebound, knock down opposing players near the ball so you can grab it off the floor.

evidence.quote: 2) knock down opposing players near the ball so you can grab the ball off

subject: Rebound
text: A player close enough to the ball will jump automatically to rebound.

evidence.quote:
If you are close enough to the ball your player will jump automatically to
rebound.

subject: 3-point shot
text: Computer teammates often let you get a screen for a 3-point shot about 3/4 down the court if the teammate runs ahead of you.

evidence.quote:
There seems to be
a pattern with the computer in which you can usually go 3/4 down the court
and have a screen for the 3-point shot if you let your computer teammate
run ahead of you.

subject: Shooting
text: Head fakes work well when shooting.

evidence.quote: Head fakes work great.

subject: Head fakes
text: Mix in some elbow throws with head fakes or you may be knocked down.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you mix in a few elbow throws though, or
you may be knocked down.

subject: Easy jam
text: When doing an easy jam with an opponent nearby, pass to your open teammate in mid-dunk to avoid being knocked down.

evidence.quote:
If you're doing an easy jam with an opponent nearby, it's best to pass to
your teammate in mid-dunk.

subject: Super dunks
text: You must be moving to perform a super dunk.

evidence.quote: SUPER DUNKS: Several different dunks - YOU MUST BE MOVING TO DUNK!

subject: Easy jam
text: Easy jam: be close to the basket and hold shoot.

evidence.quote: Easy jam: close to basket, hold shoot.

subject: 360 dunk ("Look out!")
object: near second tick on key, hold shoot
text: The 360 dunk is performed near the second tick on the key, holding shoot.

evidence.quote: "Look out!" (360 dunk): near the second tick on the key, hold shoot.

subject: Two-handed jam
object: close and above basket, hold shoot
text: The two-handed jam is performed from close and above the basket, holding shoot.

evidence.quote: Two-handed jam: from close and above the basket, hold shoot.

subject: Tomahawk jam 1
object: close and below basket, hold turbo and shoot
text: Tomahawk jam 1 is performed from close and below the basket, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote: Tomahawk jam 1: from close and below the basket, hold turbo and shoot.

subject: Tomahawk jam 2
object: middle of key, hold turbo and shoot
text: Tomahawk jam 2 is performed from the middle of the key, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote: Tomahawk jam 2: from the middle of the key, hold turbo and shoot.

subject: Tomahawk jam 3 (windmill)
object: 3/4 length of key, hold turbo and shoot
text: Tomahawk jam 3 (windmill) is performed from 3/4 length of the key, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote:
Tomahawk jam 3 (windmill): from 3/4 length of key (bottom of circle), hold
turbo and shoot.

subject: Cannonball slam (fireball)
object: top of circle, hold turbo and shoot
text: The cannonball slam (fireball) is performed from the top of the circle, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote: Cannonball slam (fireball): from top of circle, hold turbo and shoot.

subject: 720 slam (Tarzan yell / helicopter rotor)
object: corner of key or third tick outside key, hold turbo and shoot
text: The really high 720 slam is performed from a corner of the key or from outside the key near the third tick, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote:
Really high 720 slam (also the "Tarzan yell" slam or "helicopter rotor" slam):
from a corner of the key, or from outside the key near the third tick mark
on the key, hold turbo and shoot.

subject: Weird slam
object: outside key near 2nd or 3rd tick, hold turbo and shoot
text: The weird slam is performed from outside the key near the 2nd or 3rd tick, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote:
Weird slam (don't know what to call it; he puts his knees up and spins 2 or 3
times): from outside the key near 2nd or 3rd tick on the key, hold turbo
and shoot.

subject: Spreadeagled slam
text: The spreadeagled slam is performed from the middle of the key, holding shoot.

evidence.quote: Spreadeagled slam: From middle of key, hold shoot.

subject: Really high behind the back slam
text: The really high behind the back slam is performed from the middle of the key, holding shoot.

evidence.quote:
Really high behind the back slam (similar to easy jam): from middle of key,
hold shoot.

subject: Hanging rim dunk
object: third tick outside key, hold turbo and shoot
text: The dunk where the dunker hangs on the rim is performed near the third tick outside the key, holding turbo and shoot.

evidence.quote:
The dunk where the dunker hangs on the rim: near third tick on the key
(but outside the key), hold turbo and shoot.

subject: Mid-dunk pass
text: In mid-dunk, if a teammate is open, press pass to send the ball to them for an easy three.

evidence.quote:
In mid-dunk, if your teammate is open, you can pass the ball back to them by
pressing pass. Then, they can take an easy three!

subject: Backboard break
text: A backboard can be broken with specialty dunks in the fourth quarter and in any overtime period.

evidence.quote:
In the fourth quater and in any overtime periods, you can break the backboard
in a spectacular display with any specialty dunks.

subject: Dunking
text: Dunking is a bad option when time is running out, because running out of time mid-dunk is a bad decision.

evidence.quote:
When time is running out in the period, dunking isn't a good option. If time
runs out in mid-dunk, you made a "bad decision". ;)

subject: Milk the clock
object: lead of four points or more
text: With a lead of four points or more, get the ball from a basket or goaltend, stay at your end of the court and hold your position as long as you can to milk the clock.

evidence.quote:
If you have a lead of four points or more,
and get the basketball from a basket or goaltend, get the ball, stay at your
end of the court, hold your position, stay for as long as you can.

subject: Milk the clock
object: computer forced to act below 5 seconds
text: The computer stays in position until the shot clock is below 5, then forces you to take your move.

evidence.quote:
Computer will stay in it's position and do nothing until the Shot Clock counts
down below 5, then it will force you to take your move.

subject: Milk the clock
text: At 6 seconds on the shot clock, quickly pass to an open teammate or take a shot.

evidence.quote:
At 6 seconds, quickly
pass to your teammate if he's open, or if you are, take a shot.

subject: Milk the clock
text: After a missed shot, rebound, pass back to the backcourt player, and milk the clock again.

evidence.quote:
Even if you
miss, you get better a better shot at rebounding, then you can get the ball,
pass back to the man in backcourt, and milk the clock again.

subject: Milk the clock
text: The clock-milking trick works best in the fourth quarter.

evidence.quote:
This trick works
best in the fourth quarter.

subject: On fire
text: A character who makes three consecutive shots in a row is said to be on fire.

evidence.quote:
"HE'S ON FIRE!": When a character makes three consecutive shots in a row,
he is said to be "on fire".

subject: On fire
text: While on fire, a player's future shots have a much improved chance of going in, though some still miss.

evidence.quote:
After that, all his future shots will stand
a much more improved chance of entering the basket, although I have seen
some miss while on fire.

subject: On fire
object: work back of court, goaltend, steal, rebound
text: To stay on fire, work the back of the court, goaltend layups or three-pointers, and steal and rebound when possible.

evidence.quote:
When you're on fire, to stay on fire, work in the back of the court,
goaltend any layups or three-pointers, steal and rebound when possible.

subject: Heating up
object: on fire after two made shots and a third
text: Two made shots in a row is heating up, and a third made shot puts you on fire.

evidence.quote:
This also works if you're "heating up", i. e. you've made two shots in a
row and need a third to go on fire.

subject: On fire
text: While on fire you have unlimited turbo power.

evidence.quote:
Plus, when you're on fire, you have
the advantage of unlimeted turbo power, even if you're the kind of player
that holds down turbo during a game.

subject: Opponent on fire
text: The best way to take an opponent off fire is to dunk the basketball.

evidence.quote:
When someone else in on fire, the best way to get them off fire is to dunk
the basketball.

subject: On fire
text: A player stays on fire until the other team makes a shot go in their basket.

evidence.quote:
You will stay "on fire" until the other team
makes a shot go in their basket.

subject: On fire
text: On fire is usually lost after about 30 points.

evidence.quote:
You don't stay on fire forever, you lose it after a period of time. A rather
long time, it seems, usually 30 points, but you do lose it.

subject: Secret codes
text: Secret codes are entered before the tip-off while the announcer says Tonight's match up, up until the tip-off.

evidence.quote:
All secret codes are done before the Tip-off, when the announcer says,
"Tonight's match up: (Team) versus (Team)" and continued right up until
the tip-off.

subject: Big Head
object: hold joystick up, hold turbo and steal
text: To get Big Head, hold the joystick up and hold turbo and steal during Tonight's match up; your player's head becomes three times larger.

evidence.quote:
BIG HEAD: Hold joystick up and hold down Turbo and Steal at "Tonight's
match up". Gives your player a head three times larger than normal.

subject: Big Head
text: On arcade machines where Big Head is set permanently on, entering the code turns Big Head off.

evidence.quote:
Some
arcades might have their machine set to have Big Head permanently on, as it
is also an operator-adjustable feature, therefore, doing this on such a
machine will turn Big Head off.

subject: Powerup Defense
object: tap Steal or Block eight times
text: Tap Steal or Block eight times during Tonight's match up to get Powerup Defense, which gives extra defensive power.

evidence.quote:
POWERUP DEFENSE: Tap Steal or Block eight times when it says "Tonight's
match up". Eight times only. Gives you extra defensive power.

subject: Powerup Intercept
object: hold joystick and all three buttons
text: Hold the joystick and all three buttons during Tonight's match up to get Powerup Intercept, which gives extra intercept power.

evidence.quote:
POWERUP INTERCEPT: Hold down joystick and hold down all three buttons during
"Tonight's match up". Gives you extra intercept power.

subject: Powerup Offense
text: Tap Steal or Block 21 times at Tonight's match up to get Powerup Offense.

evidence.quote: POWERUP OFFENSE: Tap Steal or Block 21 times at "Tonight's match up".

subject: Powerup Offense
text: Powerup Offense is very difficult to get, so be patient.

evidence.quote:
21 times only. Gives you extra offensive power. This is a VERY DIFFICULT
power-up to get, so be patient.

subject: Powerup Defense and Intercept
object: seven shoot taps then hold joystick and all buttons
text: At Tonight's Match-Up, tap shoot seven times, then all at once hold the joystick and all three buttons, to get the Defense and Intercept combo.

evidence.quote:
At "Tonight's Match-Up", tap the shoot button seven times, then all at
once, hold down the joystick and all three buttons.

subject: Dual powerups
object: enter one code, then another while time remains
text: Dual powerups can be entered by entering the code for one first, then entering another code while time remains.

evidence.quote:
*Another way to do dual power-ups would be to enter the code for one
first, then while time remains, enter another code.

subject: Powerup Defense and Big Head
object: tap turbo six times, hold turbo and steal, hold joystick up
text: Tap turbo six times, hold turbo and steal, then hold the joystick up at Tonight's match-up to get Powerup Defense and Big Head.

evidence.quote:
POWERUP DEFENSE AND BIG HEAD: Tap turbo six times, hold turbo and steal,
then hold the joystick up at "Tonight's match-up".

subject: Fair Shake and Powerup Intercept
object: tap turbo seven times, hold buttons, hold joystick down
text: Tap turbo seven times, then hold the turbo, pass and shoot buttons, then hold the joystick down to get Fair Shake and Powerup Intercept.

evidence.quote:
FAIR SHAKE AND POWERUP INTERCEPT: Tap turbo seven times, then hold the turbo,
pass and shoot buttons, then hold the joystick down.

subject: Fair Shake and Big Head
object: press turbo eight times, hold turbo and steal down, hold joystick up
text: Press turbo eight times, then hold turbo and steal down and hold the joystick up to get Fair Shake and Big Head.

evidence.quote:
FAIR SHAKE AND BIG HEAD: Press turbo eight times, then hold turbo and steal
down, and hold the joystick up.

subject: Fair Shake
text: Tap turbo ten times when it says Tonight's match up to get Fair Shake.

evidence.quote: FAIR SHAKE: Tap turbo ten times when it says "Tonight's match up".

subject: Fair Shake
text: Fair Shake turns off the computer's cheating, and works only in four-player, three-player, or two-player games where players compete against each other.

evidence.quote:
Turns off the computer's rampant cheating. This only works in four-player
games, three player games or two player games where they compete against each
other.

subject: Fair Shake
object: All computer assistance turned off message
text: Fair Shake makes the game say All computer assistance turned off at tip-off.

evidence.quote: It will say at the tip off, "All computer assistance turned off"

subject: Fair Shake
object: human vs human and version 3.0 or greater
text: Fair Shake works only in human vs human games (1-on-1, 1-on-2, 2-on-2) on machines version 3.0 or greater.

evidence.quote:
The Fair shake can ONLY be done in Human vs. Human (1-on-1, 1-on-2, 2-on-2)
games and ONLY on machines that are version 3.0 or greater.

subject: Fair Shake
text: Fair Shake must be done by a paid player, not on an empty space.

evidence.quote:
This cannot
be done on an empty space, a paid player must be the one doing this trick.

subject: Fair Shake
text: Without Fair Shake, after a big lead over 20 points the computer makes the opponent's shots go in better and makes you go ice cold.

evidence.quote:
Why do this? Well, if you have a BIG lead over 20 points versus an opponent,
  the Computer will try to balance out things by making your opponent's
  shots go in better, while making you go ice cold.

subject: Shooting percentage
object: spin joystick clockwise and tap all three buttons
text: At Tonight's match up, spin the joystick clockwise and rapidly tap all three buttons at once until tip-off to show shooting percentage.

evidence.quote:
SHOOTING PERCENTAGE: At "Tonight's match up", spin joystick clockwise and
rapidly tap all three buttons at once until tip-off.

subject: Shooting percentage
text: A shot percentage between 01% and 99% shows below the credit counter whenever someone takes a shot (not a dunk).

evidence.quote:
Whenever anyone takes
a shot (not a dunk), a small number between 01% and 99% will show below the
credit counter.

subject: Shot percentage
text: The shot percentage is the percent chance that your shot goes in.

evidence.quote: This is the percent chance your shot has on going in.

subject: Shot percentage
text: Shot percentages are not always reliable, since 01% to 05% long shots can go in and 99% layups can miss.

evidence.quote:
I have seen some
01% to 05% shots from LONG range go in with nothing but net, and I have also
seen some 99% percent layups miss horribly off the mark, so don't take the
percentage at it's value all the time.

subject: Shot percentage display
text: On version 3.0 and later the shot percentage display is announced as Learning Mode 2; on older versions 2.0 and earlier it was announced as Shot % display activated.

evidence.quote:
On older versions of NBA Jam (2.0 and earlier) the Computer would flash the
message, "Shot % display activated". On versions that are 3.0 and later,
the Computer will say, "Shot % display activated - Learning Mode 2".

subject: Shot percentage display
text: The shot percentage display is Learning Mode 2.

evidence.quote: The Shot Percentage IS Learning Mode 2.

subject: Shot percentage display
text: The shot percentage powerup can only be done by a paid player.

evidence.quote: This is the other powerup that can only be done by a paid player.

subject: Learning Mode 1 and Learning Mode 3
text: There are Learning Mode 1 and Learning Mode 3, which the guide does not describe.

evidence.quote: There is a Learning Mode 1 and a Learning Mode 3.

subject: Shot percentage
text: Shot percentage is consistent from any given court spot; for example Petrovic is about 50-55% from one spot and 10-15% from another.

evidence.quote:
Percentage, it shows a consistent pattern from any given spot on the
court. In other words, Petrovic is consistently 50-55% from one spot
and may be 10-15% from another.

subject: Shot percentage
text: Shot percentage is affected by being on fire, proximity to the basket, the defense you face, and the lead of the game if computer assistance is not turned off.

evidence.quote:
Your shot percentage is affected by the following things, being on fire,
proximity to basket, defence you face, and the lead of the game if the
computer assistance isn't turned off.

subject: Design Team screen
object: hold all three buttons on Players 1 and 2 side and joysticks up
text: For the shortened Design Team screen, hold all three buttons on the Players 1 and 2 side and hold both joysticks up at the same time.

evidence.quote:
Hold down
all three buttons on Players 1 and 2 side, and hold the joysticks up
at the same time.

subject: Design Team screen
object: release all buttons and pull joysticks down
text: Release all buttons at once and pull down on both joysticks at the same time to bring up the Design Team screen.

evidence.quote:
Then, you have to time this right, release all buttons
at once, and pull down on both joysticks at the same time.

subject: Design Team screen
text: The Design Team screen normally cycles once every 10-15 minutes when no one is playing.

evidence.quote:
The Design Team screen will cycle through normally
once every 10-15 minutes when no one is playing

subject: Special Guests
object: initials and birthdate before picking teams
text: NBA Jam has 18 Special Guests.

evidence.quote: There are 18 Special Guests in NBA JAM, there were plans for lots more

subject: Special Guests
object: initials and birthdate before picking teams
text: Special Guests are entered using their initials and birthdate before picking teams.

evidence.quote:
They can be found by entering their initials and birthdate before picking
teams.

subject: Special Guests
text: 13 Special Guest codes are made public in the guide and in VG&CE August '93.

evidence.quote: 13 are made public, in this guide, and in VG&CE August '93.

subject: Special Guests
text: Five Special Guests did not make their codes public, including Felecia Turmell, Lorainne Olivia and Kerri Kendall Hoskins.

evidence.quote:
Five did not wish to make their codes public, including Felecia Turmell,
Lorainne Olivia and Kerri Kendall Hoskins.

subject: Special Guests
text: Special Guests seem to have their own advantages and disadvantages instead of inheriting the stats of the player they substitute for.

evidence.quote:
Though it may seem that the Special Guests inherit the stats of the
person they substitute for, the Special Guests seem to have their own
advantages and disadvantages over the character they substitute for.

subject: Special Guests
text: On version 2.0 machines Special Guests wore their own jerseys; in version 3.0 they wear the team jersey.

evidence.quote:
In machines that are Version 2.0, the special guests had their own jerseys,
but in 3.0, that has been fixed so that they wear the teams jersey.

subject: Turmell
text: Enter MJT and the birthdate March 22nd to get Turmell as a Special Guest.

evidence.quote: TURMELL: Enter MJT and the birthdate March 22nd.

subject: Turmell
text: Turmell has improved three-point shooting but a slight cost in dunking and defense.

evidence.quote:
Look for improved three
shooting, but at a slight cost of dunking and defense.

subject: Turmell
object: Golden State Warriors in place of Mullin
text: The guide recommends putting Turmell in place of Mullin for the Golden State Warriors.

evidence.quote:
We recommend you put
Turmell on in place of Mullin for the Golden State Warriors.
